notes.title: Working on game, and Youtube devlogs
notes.content:
[h2]I can just share update gifs here lol
[/h2]

I am experimenting with adding simple combat, another thing to make the game stand on it's own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/4c9f5d3f9dea9dd9f0d7bcbf4d387a87ab4effdd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/e3f0a1e1277473f6df9e4738e7489467978053b3.png[/img]

Stuff might change, but i'm thinking of adding some simple combos, to mix up the gameplay, in a way that still lets you maintain your speed!

Also i've increasingly felt that our concept art of Pengu looked cuter than his actual in-game sprite.
So I'm thinking of doing a slight redesign.
From oldest to newest, you can see some progression.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/a9e98433884f0631d41bb50692a7268f0197f0f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/58766943c1ac36d1a7f3e9f7c5ce159908329bf6.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/db75843a3ad3c33ab93887eb84513ab9bc217a53.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/5016d0c0f532dd92151bda0114ceb0c7fc2e74da.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/21899667656bbcea96d0413bf9a6b75edc974ad6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/ea8e3e2034c5950b11add352b48f0ac35514e111.png[/img][/url]

I'm also working on a 7 minute long game-dev video talking about the history of this game and some stuff that came before it. So i'd really reccomend you keep a look out on my youtube channel were it will be uploaded eventually. It's  an odd balancing act with making marketing content like youtube videos, and working on the actual game. Cause truth be told, with one person you can't do both at once. But you also need both.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/69105c88dd3d99d2e331ce468c46d2b789f5b722.gif[/img]
[i]Me having spent the last month working on a youtube video about the game instead of working on the actual game[/i]

That video will hopefully be out in the not  so far future. I realized i should probably create some more new stuff, that shows off the vision better (future city, combat, mechs) So i'm spending some time making some of that to be included in the video.

I'm figuring out all this stuff as im going, so i appreciate your support.

I'll see you on youtube [i](in hopefully not too long but who flippin knows these days)[/i]

notes.title: The Game is Announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/f18d4f12ace8a425730c107d17fa5b5e24e85d4c.png[/img]

The game is finally announced, a lot of work is ahead. But in the meantime, i hope you can enjoy the demo that's releasing soon!

It's more like an early prototype, so a lot of stuff will change, something I'm figuring out now is implementing light combat, and more story beats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542134/e3f0a1e1277473f6df9e4738e7489467978053b3.png[/img]

Regardless i hope you'll follow along with development. Please wishlist the game and tell me all your thoughts and wishes for the future!
